newsitem.headline: Furniture Brands Intl Inc Q4 oper net up.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: '96 and '95 Q4 results exclude gain on insurance settlement and depreciation and amortization related to 1992 asset revaluation.
Excluding depreciation and amortization resulting from the 1992 asset revaluation, fully diluted net earnings per share, before nonrecurring items, would have been $0.32 vs $0.24.
(All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: 1996 year revenues include those of Thomasville Furniture Industries Inc, acquired on December 29, 1995.
Excluding depreciation and amortization resulting from the 1992 asset revaluation, fully diluted net earnings per share, before nonrecurring items, for the year would have been $1.06 vs $0.80.
